CustomField.description: Written by: each call. Read by: the recall gate. A charter change that softens a prohibition is a shape change, so the version is on the row and not only in the log. The first attempt to write one threw STRING_TOO_LONG at 22 characters, which is the field refusing an incomplete provenance rather than truncating it.
